summary: Iteration 9 (Explore/Stay tabs, radius expansion, seed 484, sponsor category fix). Backend 20/20 assertions in test_iter9_explore_stay.py pass (only failing test — FF_BUILD marker in HTML — was invalid; the '285' string is not a source constant). Seed idempotency verified: two consecutive backend restarts kept the count at exactly 484 with 0 duplicate names; 36 explore cuisines x 4 = 144 rows, 16 stay cuisines x 4 = 64 rows, every (category, cuisine) pair has >=4. Radius validator now accepts 150 and rejects 151 (was capped at 50). POST /api/places/search with category=explore and =stay returns 200 with real Google Places results (Explore hero deal returned 'State Line Lookout, Palisades Interstate Park Commission' — not a restaurant, confirming _build_text_query does not append 'restaurant'). Sponsorship-request AND admin sponsor creation both accept the full 8 categories (food/drinks/bars/desserts/shops/fuel/explore/stay), fixing the two pre-existing bugs where fuel and shops/fuel were rejected. UI: all 8 mode-* tabs render at 430px width; Explore hero shows 'Can't decide what to do?' / 'Let fate pick your next adventure.' (not fuel copy); Stay shows 'basecamp' hero copy; chip labels 'Activity' and 'Stay type' render correctly; State Parks/KOA/Mini Golf/Campgrounds chips present. Radius slider aria-valuemax=150 on Explore/Stay, 100 on Food, default 50, end-label reads the dynamic max. Delivery IS correctly hidden on the reveal card in Explore mode. Meta description mentions explore/stay. FAQ code contains all 8 items including the two new ones and the renamed 'pick a place'. CRITICAL BUG FOUND: the 'more to consider' grid tiles on Explore (and by extension Stay) still render 6 visible order-dropdown-<id> buttons — the guard was extended in RestaurantCard.jsx / RevealStage.jsx but not in the grid-tile component. i18n regression confirmed: ZERO Spanish (ES) translations exist for any of the reworded hero/step/FAQ strings; non-English users see English fallback (won't crash but mixed language).

ui_bugs.issue: On category=explore (and stay) the 3-tile grid still renders visible order-dropdown-<id> buttons (6 counted). The delivery-hiding guard was extended in RestaurantCard.jsx / RevealStage.jsx reveal path but NOT in the grid-tile component. Confirmed reproducer: fill ZIP 10001, tap mode-explore, tap spin-roulette-button, wait for spin-result-card, then query [data-testid^='order-dropdown-'] — returns 6 visible BUTTON nodes.

action_items: HIGH: Extend the delivery-dropdown guard to the 'more to consider' grid-tile component (likely inside RevealStage.jsx grid section or its child card component) so explore/stay/shops/fuel do not render order-dropdown-<id> BUTTONs on the small tiles. RestaurantCard reveal path already hides it correctly.

MEDIUM: Backfill /app/frontend/src/i18n/i18n.js ES dictionary with the 15+ new/changed keys: 'Can't decide what to do?', 'Let fate pick your next adventure.', 'Need somewhere to stay?', "Let fate pick tonight's basecamp.", 'Activity', 'Stay type', 'How does Fork·Fate pick a place?', 'What are the Explore and Stay tabs?', "Why can't I order delivery from every result?", the three new How-it-works step strings, and all 8 chip-row updates. Currently 0 of these keys are translated — the app falls back to English cleanly (no undefined/blank), but non-English users will see mixed language.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx is 1473 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Consider extracting the FAQ + How-it-works sections into a dedicated component, and the mode-tabs into its own to help future edits.

The order-dropdown guard is duplicated across RestaurantCard.jsx, RevealStage.jsx, and (missing here) the grid tile. Centralising the 'category supports delivery' check into a single helper (e.g. categorySupportsDelivery(mode) in homeConstants.js) would prevent the class of bug this iteration just re-introduced.

Seed idempotency depends on hash-seeded random per (category, cuisine); good. The new DECLARED_CUISINES lists MUST stay in lock-step with EXPLORE_CUISINES / STAY_CUISINES in homeConstants.js — a mismatch would silently under-seed a chip.

FF_BUILD 285 marker referenced in the problem statement is not present as a source constant anywhere in frontend/src — if this is meant to be user-visible / logged, it should be added to a version.js or app.json config.
seed_data_creation: test_iter9_explore_stay.py creates then deletes 3 sponsors (TEST_ExploreSponsor / TEST_StaySponsor / TEST_FuelSponsor) and 3 sponsorship-requests (TEST_ExploreBiz / TEST_StayBiz / TEST_FuelBiz) via admin cleanup step. If the DELETE endpoint for sponsorship-requests does not exist, those 3 rows may remain — recommend main agent verify /api/admin/sponsorship-requests exists and clean up if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite test_iter9_explore_stay.py verifies seed=484, radius validator 150/151, explore/stay search, and 8-category sponsor validation. Seed idempotency was manually verified by restarting backend twice. The one FAILED test in that suite (test_ff_build_285) is a false-positive — FF_BUILD is not a source constant and can be ignored. Grid-tile delivery guard bug reproduces reliably at 430x900 with ZIP 10001 on mode-explore.
rca_of_issue: Root cause of grid-tile delivery leak: iteration 9 extended the 'hide delivery for shops/fuel/explore/stay' guard in RestaurantCard.jsx (reveal card) and RevealStage.jsx order-dropdown-trigger conditional, but the smaller 'more to consider' grid tile that renders order-dropdown-<id> BUTTON nodes was missed. Reveal card hides correctly; grid tiles do not. Reproduction: fill ZIP 10001 → tap mode-explore → tap spin-roulette-button → wait for spin-result-card → six visible order-dropdown-<id> BUTTONs remain in DOM. Mitigation: add the same categorySupportsDelivery gate around the grid-tile order-dropdown render (search for order-dropdown-${id} in the codebase — likely in RevealStage.jsx grid section).
